主要内容: Tucson Electric Power Company (TEP) filed a general rate case with the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) in April 2019, requesting new rates by May 1, 2020. On February 13, 2020, the Administrative Law Judge (ALJ) issued a procedural order, extending the hearing to two additional days in April 2020. Briefs are to be filed by the parties in May 2020, after which the ALJ will prepare and submit a recommended opinion and order to the ACC for consideration. Any rate changes will depend on an ACC order. TEP cannot predict the timing or outcome of the proceeding. The filing is part of the SEC Form 8-K, dated February 21, 2020, and signed by Frank P. Marino, Sr. Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of TEP.
